method.episodes: One entry when the directional trend changes; timestamp gaps do not create new episodes.
method.bucket_assignment: Each signal hour by its own score/alignment; episodes by their first hour.
method.forward_returns: Exact elapsed-hour close; missing timestamps excluded. Signal hours, not episodes.
method.censoring: Unresolved trades at end of data excluded; baseline and paired rule use only entries with both directions resolved.
method.baseline: Equal-weight long and short outcomes at each eligible episode entry.
method.timeout: Exit at 72 elapsed hours, or next observed open if the deadline falls in a gap.
method.execution: Signal at bar close; adverse opening gaps fill at the open, other stops at stop; same-bar stop before target.
method.limitations: Assumes timestamps mark hourly bar opens and bars last one hour. Partial/irregular bars require source-specific handling; spread, slippage and funding excluded.
